extension.name: Event Triggers
extension.description: Timer, SMS (Twilio), and email (SendGrid) event providers as flow trigger nodes.
extension.summary: Design-time node descriptors for event-based triggers; runtime execution delegated to the events-* packs.
node.timer-trigger.label: Timer / Schedule
node.timer-trigger.description: Fire a flow after a configurable delay.
node.timer-trigger.config.default_delay_: Default delay in seconds before the timer fires (default 30)
node.timer-trigger.config.persistence_ke: Override prefix for persisted scheduled entries
node.sms-trigger.label: SMS (Twilio)
node.sms-trigger.description: Start a flow when an inbound SMS is received via Twilio.
node.sms-trigger.config.messaging_provid: Messaging provider ID (routes credentials and persistence keys)
node.sms-trigger.config.from: Default sender number for outbound SMS
node.sms-trigger.config.persistence_key_: Override prefix for persisted inbound requests
node.email-trigger.label: Email (SendGrid)
node.email-trigger.description: Start a flow when an inbound email is received via SendGrid inbound parse.
node.email-trigger.config.messaging_prov: Messaging provider ID (routes credentials and persistence keys)
node.email-trigger.config.from: Optional default From address for outbound integrations
node.email-trigger.config.persistence_ke: Override prefix for persisted inbound requests
